questions.text: What is Microsoft Excel mainly used for?
options: Browsing the internet and sending emails to friends only
Drawing pictures and editing photographs and videos only
Writing long letters and printing them for school only
Organising information in tables, doing maths and making charts

questions.text: A row in Excel goes:
options: Diagonally from corner to corner
From top to bottom of the sheet
Across, from left to right
Only in column A of the sheet

questions.text: A column in Excel goes:
options: Diagonally
Across, from left to right
From top to bottom
Only in row 1

questions.text: Cell A1 is where:
options: The formula bar starts
Column A meets Row 1
Row A meets Column 1
The ribbon ends

questions.text: What is the Ribbon?
options: The area at the top with the tabs and buttons
The name that is written on each worksheet tab
A picture of numbers such as a column chart
A single box where a row meets a column

questions.text: Every formula in Excel begins with which symbol?
A1 contains 10 and A2 contains 5. You type =A1+A2 in A3. What does Excel show?
B1 contains 20 and B2 contains 7. What does =B1-B2 show?
Which symbol does Excel use to multiply?
options: x

questions.text: Which symbol does Excel use to divide?
C1 contains 6 and C2 contains 4. What does =C1*C2 show?
D1 contains 24 and D2 contains 6. What does =D1/D2 show?
What is the AutoSum symbol?
options: Σ
π

questions.text: A1 to A5 contain 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50. What does =SUM(A1:A5) show?
B1 to B4 contain 80, 70, 90 and 60. What does =AVERAGE(B1:B4) show?
C1 to C5 contain 55, 88, 72, 91 and 67. What does =MIN(C1:C5) show?
C1 to C5 contain 55, 88, 72, 91 and 67. What does =MAX(C1:C5) show?
What does the COUNT function do?
options: Finds the average of the numbers in the cells
Finds the smallest number in a group of cells
Adds all of the numbers in the cells together
Counts how many cells contain numbers

questions.text: Which of these is a correct formula?
options: =B1xB2
=A1+A
SUM(A1:A5)
=SUM(A1:A5)

questions.text: Which shortcut copies the selected cell?
options: Ctrl + V
Ctrl + X
Ctrl + F
Ctrl + C

questions.text: What does Cut and Paste do?
options: Moves information from one place to another
Makes a copy and leaves the original in place
Changes the font and the colour of the words
Deletes the information and cannot bring it back

questions.text: Which shortcut opens Replace, to change one word into another?
options: Ctrl + Z
Ctrl + H
Ctrl + S
Ctrl + B

questions.text: What does Conditional Formatting do?
options: Sorts the names in a list from A to Z
Changes the colour of a cell when it meets a rule
Adds up all the numbers in the selected cells
Inserts a picture from the computer into a cell

questions.text: Merge & Center is used to:
options: Copy a whole table to another place in the sheet
Join cells and centre a title across columns
Delete a column that you do not need any more
Add up the numbers in two cells next to each other

questions.text: What does Wrap Text do?
options: Makes long text fit inside the cell
Adds a border around the edge of the cell
Changes the colour of the text in the cell
Merges the cell with the cell below it

questions.text: Which tab do you use to insert a chart?
options: Data
Insert
Home
Draw

questions.text: What is a chart for?
options: Saving the workbook to the Documents folder
Adding up numbers automatically in a new column
Correcting the spelling mistakes in a worksheet
Turning numbers into a picture so you can compare them quickly

questions.text: Which tab has Sort and Filter?
options: Insert
Draw
Home
Data

questions.text: You filter the Class column and choose P5. What happens?
options: All of the P5 students are deleted from the list
The Class column is removed from the table
The names are sorted from A to Z in the list
Only the students in P5 are shown

questions.text: What does Sort A to Z do to a list of names?
options: Deletes the repeated names from the list
Puts the names in alphabetical order
Colours the names in a different colour
Counts how many names are in the list

questions.text: What does a hyperlink do?
options: Adds two numbers together in a new cell
Opens a website or another file when you click it
Draws a shape on the worksheet for you
Changes the height of a row in the sheet

questions.text: Which Insert item lets you place words anywhere on the worksheet?
options: Chart
Text Box
Table
SmartArt

questions.text: What is SmartArt used for?
options: Finding and replacing words in a sheet
Sorting a list of data by the marks
Showing ideas with colourful diagrams
Adding up numbers in a column quickly

questions.text: What does Format Painter do?
options: Copies the look of one cell or heading to another
Sorts a list of names from A to Z
Adds up the numbers in a group of cells
Inserts a picture from the computer
